prompts: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this isometric room ONLY in the bed area. The bed must be rotated a quarter turn relative to current bed so its LONG SIDE runs PARALLEL and FLUSH to the LEFT TALL WALL (the wall with bookshelf), NOT perpendicular to that wall and NOT along the low foreground parapet. Position it in the front-left part of the room. Head/pillow at the bookshelf end, foot near the leftmost foreground corner. Looking at this image, the mattress long axis runs from upper-right to lower-left, parallel to the wall/floor junction of the left tall wall. Widen the mattress to a comfortable semi-double around 1.4m x 2.1m, sufficient for a future reclining avatar. Make a low graphite metal bed, cyan battery indicators, one generous pillow, dark quilt with cyan piping; headboard at the upper-right end nearest the bookshelf, footboard lower-left. Approximate mattress four corners on 1672x941: head/wall (460,402), head/room (710,531), foot/room (420,675), foot/wall (198,547). The wall-side long mattress edge from (460,402) to (198,547) must lie along the left wall, without a triangular gap. Natural perspective and realistic 3D-rendered furniture matching original. It may occlude the bottom of the bookshelf naturally. Preserve bookshelf upper shelves, desk, chair, monitor, fans, radio tower, CPU, brain engraving, cables, walls and room camera exactly. No character. Full room, same framing. Do not retain the old bed orientation.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Image1 is target horizontal room; Image2 is authoritative corrected overview of this same room. Replace ONLY the bed in image1 with the SAME bed placement and orientation as image2. The bed LONG SIDE is flush to the LEFT TALL WALL with bookshelf. Rotate the old bed 90 degrees on the floor: pillow and headboard at the RIGHT/DEEP end near bookshelf, footboard at the LEFT/NEAR end near left wall corner. Long axis runs roughly left-to-right, rising slightly toward the back/right, PARALLEL to left wall base. Bed must no longer stick out perpendicular from left wall. Comfortable WIDE semi-double mattress 1.4m x 2.1m, one large pillow at right end, graphite quilt with cyan piping, battery-marked graphite headboard on right end, matching cyan cells on left footboard and side. Natural low camera view matching the rest of image1. Bed occupies approx x20..730,y430..745; headboard near bookshelf at x500..720, footboard near x20..220. Long wall-side bed edge follows wall/floor line toward bookshelf with NO triangular floor gap behind bed. Bed may naturally cover lowest part of bookshelf, preserve upper shelves. Preserve ALL other furniture exactly: desk, chair, monitor, fan positions, tower, CPU engraving and pixels, cables, room camera and lighting. No avatar, no text, no extra furniture. Full 16:9 room, same framing.
